title.en: The drill: a method sheet and practice for every section
title.zh: 练习：方法表，以及 A、B、C 三部分的练习

description.en: Every calculation family on one sheet, then Section A short answers, Section B calculations with fresh numbers and a backpropagation step, and two Section C design questions.
description.zh: 所有计算类型汇成一张表；然后是 A 部分简答、B 部分换了数的计算（含一步反向传播）、以及两道 C 部分设计题。

name.en: Section A: explain and compare in a few lines
name.zh: A 部分：几行话解释与比较

name.en: Section B: the calculations by hand

name.zh: C 部分：设计并说明理由

description.en: Judging a classifier on imbalanced data by accuracy
description.zh: 在类别不均衡的数据上用准确率评价分类器

description.en: Mixing up what bagging and boosting reduce
description.zh: 把 bagging 和 boosting 各自降低什么弄反

text.en: Four parts, in the order of the exam: **the method sheet**, then **A** (short answers), **B** (calculations) and **C** (design). Calculations use fresh numbers; the answers are computed, and each question says how to round.
text.zh: 四部分，顺序和考试一致：**方法表**，然后 **A**（简答）、**B**（计算）、**C**（设计）。计算题用全新的数；答案都是算出来的，每题注明怎么取整。

text.en: Try each one under time: about 1.2 minutes per mark, so a 2-mark short answer is 2-3 minutes and a calculation worth 6 marks about 7. If a row of the sheet does not make sense, go back to its lesson instead of memorising it.
text.zh: 每题限时做：大约每分 1.2 分钟，2 分的简答 2-3 分钟，6 分的计算约 7 分钟。方法表里哪一行看不明白，就回到对应的课，别硬背。

rows.en: Entropy, information gain, gain ratio
rows.zh: 熵、信息增益、增益率

rows.en: $0 \le H \le \log_2(\text{classes})$; a pure node has $H = 0$; $0 \le \mathrm{IG} \le H(S)$
rows.zh: $0 \le H \le \log_2(\text{类数})$；纯节点 $H = 0$；$0 \le \mathrm{IG} \le H(S)$

rows.en: PMI and MI
rows.zh: PMI 与 MI

rows.en: independent $\Rightarrow$ PMI $= 0$; MI $\ge 0$ always, PMI can be negative
rows.zh: 独立 $\Rightarrow$ PMI $= 0$；MI 永远 $\ge 0$，PMI 可以为负

rows.en: Naive Bayes with smoothing
rows.zh: 带平滑的朴素贝叶斯

rows: $\hat{c} = \arg\max_c P(c)\prod_i P(x_i \mid c)$ · $P(x_i = j \mid c) = \frac{n(x_i = j, c) + \alpha}{n(c) + \alpha V}$

rows.en: each smoothed distribution sums to 1 over the $V$ values; compare unnormalised scores, divide by their sum only if asked for a probability; use logs for many features
rows.zh: 平滑后每个分布在 $V$ 个取值上和为 1；比较未归一化的得分，只有题目要概率时才除以它们的和；特征多时用对数

rows.en: Logistic regression: prediction and a gradient step
rows.zh: 逻辑回归：预测与一步梯度

rows.en: $\hat{y} > 0.5 \iff z > 0$; the step moves $\hat{y}$ toward $y$; features with $x_j = 0$ do not change
rows.zh: $\hat{y} > 0.5 \iff z > 0$；这一步让 $\hat{y}$ 靠近 $y$；$x_j = 0$ 的特征权重不变

title.zh: 方法表 2：几何与神经网络

rows.en: Distances and k-NN voting
rows.zh: 距离与 k-NN 投票

rows.en: Euclidean $\sqrt{\sum_j (a_j - b_j)^2}$ · Manhattan $\sum_j |a_j - b_j|$ · Hamming: number of differing values · weight $w_j = \frac{1}{d_j + \epsilon}$
rows.zh: 欧氏距离 $\sqrt{\sum_j (a_j - b_j)^2}$ · 曼哈顿距离 $\sum_j |a_j - b_j|$ · 汉明距离：取值不同的个数 · 权重 $w_j = \frac{1}{d_j + \epsilon}$

rows.en: take the $k$ smallest distances; with weights, add $w_j$ per class; scale features first; $k$ odd avoids binary ties
rows.zh: 取最小的 $k$ 个距离；加权时按类累加 $w_j$；先缩放特征；二分类 $k$ 取奇数可避免平票

rows.en: Perceptron update
rows.zh: 感知机更新

rows.en: after the update $y\,\theta^\top\mathbf{x}$ grew by $\eta\lVert\mathbf{x}\rVert^2$; correct points leave $\theta$ alone
rows.zh: 更新后 $y\,\theta^\top\mathbf{x}$ 增加了 $\eta\lVert\mathbf{x}\rVert^2$；分对的点不改 $\theta$

rows.en: SVM margin
rows.zh: SVM 间隔

rows.en: constraints $y_i(\mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{x}_i + b) \ge 1$ · margin width $= 2/\lVert\mathbf{w}\rVert$ · distance of $\mathbf{x}$ to the boundary $= |\mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{x} + b|/\lVert\mathbf{w}\rVert$
rows.zh: 约束 $y_i(\mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{x}_i + b) \ge 1$ · 间隔宽度 $= 2/\lVert\mathbf{w}\rVert$ · $\mathbf{x}$ 到边界的距离 $= |\mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{x} + b|/\lVert\mathbf{w}\rVert$

rows.en: support vectors have $y_i(\mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{x}_i + b) = 1$ exactly; a larger $\lVert\mathbf{w}\rVert$ means a narrower margin
rows.zh: 支持向量恰好满足 $y_i(\mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{x}_i + b) = 1$；$\lVert\mathbf{w}\rVert$ 越大间隔越窄

rows.en: One backpropagation step
rows.zh: 一步反向传播

rows.en: forward $z^{(l)} = W^{(l)}a^{(l-1)}$, $a^{(l)} = g(z^{(l)})$ · output (sigmoid + cross-entropy) $\delta^{(L)} = \hat{y} - y$ · hidden $\delta^{(l)} = \big(W^{(l+1)\top}\delta^{(l+1)}\big)\odot g'(z^{(l)})$ · $\partial L/\partial W^{(l)} = \delta^{(l)}a^{(l-1)\top}$ · $W \leftarrow W - \eta\,\partial L/\partial W$
rows.zh: 前向 $z^{(l)} = W^{(l)}a^{(l-1)}$，$a^{(l)} = g(z^{(l)})$ · 输出层（sigmoid + 交叉熵）$\delta^{(L)} = \hat{y} - y$ · 隐藏层 $\delta^{(l)} = \big(W^{(l+1)\top}\delta^{(l+1)}\big)\odot g'(z^{(l)})$ · $\partial L/\partial W^{(l)} = \delta^{(l)}a^{(l-1)\top}$ · $W \leftarrow W - \eta\,\partial L/\partial W$

rows.en: sigmoid: $g' = a(1 - a)$; shapes: $\delta^{(l)}$ has one entry per unit of layer $l$; the loss should drop after the step
rows.zh: sigmoid：$g' = a(1 - a)$；形状：$\delta^{(l)}$ 在第 $l$ 层每个单元各一项；这一步之后损失应当下降

text.en: The formulas are printed in the exam. What the sheet adds is the check in the last column: a ten-second test that catches most arithmetic slips.
text.zh: 考试里这些公式会印出来。方法表多出来的是最后一列：十秒钟的检验，能抓住大部分算错的地方。

rows.en: Precision, recall, F1; macro and micro
rows.zh: 精确率、召回率、F1；宏平均与微平均

rows.en: $P = \frac{TP}{TP + FP}$ · $R = \frac{TP}{TP + FN}$ · $F_1 = \frac{2PR}{P + R}$ · macro: average the per-class values · micro: pool $TP, FP, FN$ over classes first
rows.zh: $P = \frac{TP}{TP + FP}$ · $R = \frac{TP}{TP + FN}$ · $F_1 = \frac{2PR}{P + R}$ · 宏平均：对各类的值取平均 · 微平均：先把各类的 $TP, FP, FN$ 汇总

rows.en: precision reads a column of the confusion matrix, recall a row; with one label per instance micro-$F_1$ equals accuracy; macro treats classes equally, micro treats instances equally
rows.zh: 精确率读混淆矩阵的列，召回率读行；每个样本一个标签时，微平均 $F_1$ 等于准确率；宏平均平等对待类别，微平均平等对待样本

rows.en: Bias and variance: which remedy
rows.zh: 偏差与方差：用什么药

rows.en: high bias (train and validation error both high): more complex model, add features, boosting · high variance (big gap): simpler model, fewer features, more data, bagging
rows.zh: 高偏差（训练和验证误差都高）：更复杂的模型、加特征、boosting · 高方差（差距大）：更简单的模型、少特征、更多数据、bagging

rows.en: read the learning curve: the gap between the curves says variance, the height of both says bias
rows.zh: 读学习曲线：两条线的差距看方差，两条线的高度看偏差

rows.en: AdaBoost weights
rows.zh: AdaBoost 权重

rows: $\varepsilon = \sum_j w_j[\,h(\mathbf{x}_j) \ne y_j]$ · $\alpha = \tfrac12\ln\frac{1 - \varepsilon}{\varepsilon}$ · $w_j \leftarrow w_j e^{-\alpha y_j h(\mathbf{x}_j)}/Z$

rows.en: $\alpha > 0$ iff $\varepsilon < 0.5$; after normalising, the misclassified instances hold total weight exactly $0.5$
rows.zh: $\alpha > 0$ 当且仅当 $\varepsilon < 0.5$；归一化之后，分错的样本总权重恰好是 $0.5$

rows.en: k-means
rows.zh: k-means

rows.en: assign each point to the nearest centroid · $\mu_k \leftarrow$ mean of its points · $\mathrm{WCSS} = \sum_k\sum_{x \in C_k}\lVert x - \mu_k\rVert^2$
rows.zh: 每个点分给最近的中心 · $\mu_k \leftarrow$ 该簇各点的均值 · $\mathrm{WCSS} = \sum_k\sum_{x \in C_k}\lVert x - \mu_k\rVert^2$

rows.en: WCSS never increases from one step to the next; run from several starts and keep the lowest
rows.zh: WCSS 一步一步不会上升；多个初值各跑一遍，留下最低的

rows.en: Hierarchical linkage
rows.zh: 层次聚类的连接方式

rows.en: single $= \min d(a, b)$ · complete $= \max d(a, b)$ · average $=$ mean of all pairwise $d(a, b)$, over $a \in A, b \in B$
rows.zh: 单连接 $= \min d(a, b)$ · 全连接 $= \max d(a, b)$ · 平均连接 $=$ 所有成对 $d(a, b)$ 的均值，$a \in A, b \in B$

rows.en: single $\le$ average $\le$ complete, always; merge the pair with the smallest linkage
rows.zh: 始终有 单连接 $\le$ 平均 $\le$ 全连接；合并连接距离最小的一对

text.en: One to three lines each. A full-mark answer states the difference or the reason, not the textbook around it. Write your own answer first, then compare with the key points.
text.zh: 每题一到三行。满分答案只说区别或理由，不抄一段教科书。先自己写，再对照要点。

title.zh: 生成式 vs 判别式

prompt.en: Compare generative and discriminative classifiers. Name one example of each. [3 marks]
prompt.zh: 比较生成式与判别式分类器，各举一个例子。[3 分]

key_points.en: Generative models P(x, y) (or P(x | y) and P(y)); discriminative models P(y | x) or the boundary directly
key_points.zh: 生成式建模 P(x, y)（或 P(x | y) 与 P(y)）；判别式直接建模 P(y | x) 或边界

key_points.en: Generative can generate new samples and handles a class-conditional story; needs more data / often a worse classifier
key_points.zh: 生成式能生成新样本，但需要更多数据、分类效果常常较弱

key_points.en: Discriminative focuses on prediction and is often more accurate; cannot generate data
key_points.zh: 判别式专注预测，通常更准，但不能生成数据

key_points.en: Examples: naive Bayes (generative); logistic regression, SVM, trees (discriminative)
key_points.zh: 例子：朴素贝叶斯（生成式）；逻辑回归、SVM、决策树（判别式）

model_answer.en: A generative classifier models the joint distribution P(x, y), e.g. P(x | y)P(y) as in naive Bayes, so it can generate new samples but needs more data and is often a weaker classifier. A discriminative classifier models P(y | x) or the boundary directly, e.g. logistic regression, which usually predicts better but cannot generate data.
model_answer.zh:
A generative classifier models the joint distribution P(x, y), e.g. P(x | y)P(y) as in naive Bayes, so it can generate new samples but needs more data and is often a weaker classifier. A discriminative classifier models P(y | x) or the boundary directly, e.g. logistic regression, which usually predicts better but cannot generate data.

（考试用英文作答，以上是一份英文参考答案。）

explain.en: Say what each one models, then what that buys or costs. The two examples show you know the difference.
explain.zh: 先说各自建模什么，再说得失。两个例子表明你真懂了区别。

prompt.en: Why is naive Bayes called "naive", and what does the assumption make possible? [3 marks]
prompt.zh: 朴素贝叶斯为什么叫“朴素”？这个假设使什么成为可能？[3 分]

key_points.en: The assumption: features are conditionally independent given the class
key_points.zh: 假设：给定类别时，特征条件独立

key_points.en: So P(x1..xn | c) factorises into a product of P(xi | c)
key_points.zh: 于是 P(x1..xn | c) 分解为 P(xi | c) 的乘积

key_points.en: Possible: few parameters (one small table per feature) and counting estimates; avoids estimating the joint over all features
key_points.zh: 好处：参数少（每个特征一张小表），用计数就能估计，不必估计所有特征的联合分布

key_points.en: Naive because features are usually correlated (e.g. words), yet it often still classifies well
key_points.zh: 叫“朴素”，是因为特征往往相关（如词），但它常常仍然分得不错

model_answer.en: It assumes the features are conditionally independent given the class, so P(x1, ..., xn | c) = prod_i P(xi | c). This replaces one huge joint distribution by n small tables that can be estimated by counting, which makes it cheap and workable with little data. It is naive because real features (e.g. words) are usually correlated.
model_answer.zh:
It assumes the features are conditionally independent given the class, so P(x1, ..., xn | c) = prod_i P(xi | c). This replaces one huge joint distribution by n small tables that can be estimated by counting, which makes it cheap and workable with little data. It is naive because real features (e.g. words) are usually correlated.

（考试用英文作答，以上是一份英文参考答案。）

explain.en: The mark is for "conditionally independent given the class" and for what the factorisation buys. Not just "features are independent".
explain.zh: 得分点是“给定类别时条件独立”以及分解带来什么。只写“特征独立”不够。

prompt.en: A word never appears in the spam training emails. What goes wrong in naive Bayes, and how does Laplace smoothing fix it? What does it cost? [3 marks]
prompt.zh: 某个词在垃圾邮件训练集里从没出现过。朴素贝叶斯会出什么问题？拉普拉斯平滑怎么修复？代价是什么？[3 分]

key_points.en: P(word | spam) = 0 makes the whole product, hence P(spam | x), zero whatever the other words say
key_points.zh: P(词 | 垃圾) = 0 会让整个乘积、也就是 P(垃圾 | x) 变成 0，不论其他词怎么说

key_points.en: Laplace adds a pseudocount alpha to every count: (count + alpha) / (n_c + alpha V), so no probability is zero
key_points.zh: 拉普拉斯给每个计数加伪计数 alpha：(count + alpha) / (n_c + alpha V)，没有概率为 0

key_points.en: Cost: bias (no longer the maximum likelihood estimate); gain: lower variance
key_points.zh: 代价：引入偏差（不再是极大似然估计）；好处：方差更低

model_answer.en: An unseen word gives P(word | spam) = 0, which zeroes the product so the email can never be classified as spam, however spammy the other words. Laplace smoothing adds a pseudocount alpha to each count, P = (count + alpha) / (n_spam + alpha V), so nothing is impossible. It adds some bias (it is no longer the maximum likelihood estimate) but lowers variance.
model_answer.zh:
An unseen word gives P(word | spam) = 0, which zeroes the product so the email can never be classified as spam, however spammy the other words. Laplace smoothing adds a pseudocount alpha to each count, P = (count + alpha) / (n_spam + alpha V), so nothing is impossible. It adds some bias (it is no longer the maximum likelihood estimate) but lowers variance.

（考试用英文作答，以上是一份英文参考答案。）

explain.en: Three beats: the zero kills the product, the pseudocount formula, bias for variance.
explain.zh: 三个要点：零概率毁掉乘积，伪计数公式，用偏差换方差。

title.zh: Bagging 与 boosting 的对比

prompt.en: Compare bagging and boosting: how are the base classifiers built, how are they combined, and which error does each mainly reduce? [4 marks]
prompt.zh: 比较 bagging 和 boosting：基础分类器怎么构造、怎么合并、各自主要降低哪种误差？[4 分]

key_points.en: Bagging: parallel, independent classifiers on bootstrap samples; Boosting: sequential, each focuses on instances the previous got wrong (reweighting)
key_points.zh: Bagging：并行、在自助采样上训练相互独立的分类器；Boosting：串行，每个重点关注前一个分错的样本（重新加权）

key_points.en: Bagging: simple (equal) vote or average; Boosting: weighted vote by classifier accuracy (alpha)
key_points.zh: Bagging：等权投票或平均；Boosting：按分类器准确度（alpha）加权投票

key_points.en: Bagging mainly reduces variance; boosting mainly reduces bias
key_points.zh: Bagging 主要降低方差；boosting 主要降低偏差

key_points.en: Boosting is more prone to overfitting (noisy labels) and is not parallelisable
key_points.zh: Boosting 更容易过拟合（噪声标签），也不能并行

model_answer.en: Bagging trains independent classifiers in parallel on bootstrap samples and combines them by a simple vote or average, which mainly reduces variance. Boosting trains classifiers sequentially, each concentrating on the instances the previous ones got wrong, and combines them by a vote weighted by each classifier's accuracy, which mainly reduces bias; it is more prone to overfitting.
model_answer.zh:
Bagging trains independent classifiers in parallel on bootstrap samples and combines them by a simple vote or average, which mainly reduces variance. Boosting trains classifiers sequentially, each concentrating on the instances the previous ones got wrong, and combines them by a vote weighted by each classifier's accuracy, which mainly reduces bias; it is more prone to overfitting.

（考试用英文作答，以上是一份英文参考答案。）

explain.en: Four contrasts in two lines: parallel/sequential, equal/weighted vote, variance/bias, and the overfitting caveat.
explain.zh: 两行里四组对比：并行/串行，等权/加权投票，方差/偏差，再加过拟合这个提醒。

prompt.en: Why do we use k-fold cross-validation instead of a single train/test split, and why should the folds be stratified for classification? [3 marks]
prompt.zh: 为什么用 k 折交叉验证而不是只切一次训练/测试集？分类时为什么折要分层？[3 分]

key_points.en: A single split gives a noisy estimate that depends on which instances landed in the test set; k-fold averages over k splits, so lower variance
key_points.zh: 一次切分的估计带噪声，取决于哪些样本落在测试集；k 折对 k 次切分取平均，方差更小

key_points.en: Every instance is used for testing once and for training k-1 times: uses the data efficiently
key_points.zh: 每个样本测试一次、训练 k-1 次：数据利用充分

key_points.en: Stratified: each fold keeps the class proportions, so rare classes appear in every fold and estimates are stable
key_points.zh: 分层：每折保持类别比例，稀有类出现在每一折里，估计更稳定

model_answer.en: One split gives an estimate that depends on luck in which instances are held out. k-fold cross-validation tests on every instance once and averages k estimates, so it is less variable and uses the data efficiently. Stratifying keeps the class proportions in every fold, so rare classes are present in each test fold.
model_answer.zh:
One split gives an estimate that depends on luck in which instances are held out. k-fold cross-validation tests on every instance once and averages k estimates, so it is less variable and uses the data efficiently. Stratifying keeps the class proportions in every fold, so rare classes are present in each test fold.

（考试用英文作答，以上是一份英文参考答案。）

explain.en: Name the problem (one lucky split), then the fix (average over k), then stratification.
explain.zh: 先说问题（一次切分靠运气），再说解法（k 次平均），最后说分层。

prompt.en: Why can the perceptron learning rule not be used to train a multi-layer perceptron? What is used instead? [3 marks]
prompt.zh: 为什么不能用感知机学习规则来训练多层感知机？实际用什么？[3 分]

key_points.en: The rule needs the true target for each unit: theta <- theta + eta y x only works where y is known
key_points.zh: 这条规则需要每个单元的真实目标：theta <- theta + eta y x 只在 y 已知处有效

key_points.en: In an MLP the hidden units have no known target; only the output layer has y
key_points.zh: MLP 的隐藏单元没有已知目标，只有输出层有 y

key_points.en: Instead: backpropagation applies the chain rule to propagate the output error back to every weight, and gradient descent updates them (needs a differentiable activation)
key_points.zh: 改用反向传播：用链式法则把输出误差传回每个权重，再做梯度下降（激活函数需可导）

model_answer.en: The perceptron rule compares a unit's output with its true target, but in an MLP only the output layer has targets; hidden units have none. Backpropagation instead uses the chain rule to send the output error back as error terms delta to every layer, giving the gradient of the loss for each weight, which gradient descent then uses to update them. This needs differentiable activations.
model_answer.zh:
The perceptron rule compares a unit's output with its true target, but in an MLP only the output layer has targets; hidden units have none. Backpropagation instead uses the chain rule to send the output error back as error terms delta to every layer, giving the gradient of the loss for each weight, which gradient descent then uses to update them. This needs differentiable activations.

（考试用英文作答，以上是一份英文参考答案。）

explain.en: The missing piece is the target of the hidden units. Backprop supplies it through the chain rule.
explain.zh: 缺的是隐藏单元的目标。反向传播用链式法则把它补上。

title.zh: Filter 与 wrapper 的对比

prompt.en: Contrast filter and wrapper feature selection. Give one example of each and one disadvantage of each. [4 marks]
prompt.zh: 对比 filter 与 wrapper 特征选择，各举一例并各说一个缺点。[4 分]

key_points.en: Filter: scores features with a statistic independent of any classifier (e.g. MI, PMI); cheap
key_points.zh: Filter：用与分类器无关的统计量给特征打分（如 MI、PMI），便宜

key_points.en: Filter weakness: ignores the classifier and feature interactions / redundancy
key_points.zh: Filter 的缺点：不考虑分类器，也不考虑特征间的相互作用和冗余

key_points.en: Wrapper: searches subsets by training and evaluating the classifier (e.g. sequential forward selection, backward elimination)
key_points.zh: Wrapper：训练并评估分类器来搜索特征子集（如顺序前向选择、后向消除）

key_points.en: Wrapper weakness: expensive (many model fits), risk of overfitting the selection to the validation data
key_points.zh: Wrapper 的缺点：开销大（要拟合很多次模型），选择可能对验证数据过拟合

model_answer.en: A filter scores each feature by a statistic that does not involve the classifier, e.g. mutual information with the class; it is cheap but ignores the classifier and interactions between features. A wrapper searches feature subsets by training and evaluating the classifier, e.g. sequential forward selection; it fits the classifier but is expensive and can overfit the validation data.
model_answer.zh:
A filter scores each feature by a statistic that does not involve the classifier, e.g. mutual information with the class; it is cheap but ignores the classifier and interactions between features. A wrapper searches feature subsets by training and evaluating the classifier, e.g. sequential forward selection; it fits the classifier but is expensive and can overfit the validation data.

（考试用英文作答，以上是一份英文参考答案。）

explain.en: Each side needs: what it uses to score, an example, a weakness. The classic contrast is cost versus fit to the classifier.
explain.zh: 每一边都要：用什么打分、一个例子、一个缺点。经典对比是成本 vs 贴合分类器。

title.zh: k-means 为什么要多次初始化

prompt.en: Why is k-means usually run several times from different initial centroids? [2 marks]
prompt.zh: k-means 为什么通常要用不同初始中心跑多次？[2 分]

key_points.en: k-means only converges to a local minimum of WCSS, which depends on the initial centroids
key_points.zh: k-means 只收敛到 WCSS 的局部最小值，取决于初始中心

key_points.en: Run several restarts and keep the solution with the lowest WCSS
key_points.zh: 多次重启，保留 WCSS 最低的解

model_answer.en: Each iteration lowers the within-cluster sum of squares, but the objective is not convex, so k-means stops in a local minimum that depends on the starting centroids. Running it several times and keeping the run with the lowest WCSS gives a better clustering.
model_answer.zh:
Each iteration lowers the within-cluster sum of squares, but the objective is not convex, so k-means stops in a local minimum that depends on the starting centroids. Running it several times and keeping the run with the lowest WCSS gives a better clustering.

（考试用英文作答，以上是一份英文参考答案。）

explain.en: Two ideas only: local optimum, and keep the best of several runs. Two marks, two lines.
explain.zh: 只有两点：局部最优，以及多次取最好。两分，两行。

prompt.en: State what equalised odds requires of a classifier with respect to a protected attribute, and say how it differs from equal opportunity. [3 marks]
prompt.zh: 说明 equalised odds 对分类器关于受保护属性的要求，并说明它和 equal opportunity 的区别。[3 分]

key_points.en: True positive rate is equal across groups: P(yhat=1 | y=1, A=a) the same for all a
key_points.zh: 各组的真正例率相等：对所有 a，P(yhat=1 | y=1, A=a) 相同

key_points.en: False positive rate is equal across groups too: P(yhat=1 | y=0, A=a) the same for all a
key_points.zh: 各组的假正例率也相等：对所有 a，P(yhat=1 | y=0, A=a) 相同

key_points.en: Equal opportunity requires only the first (equal TPR among the truly positive); equalised odds is the stronger condition of both
key_points.zh: Equal opportunity 只要求第一条（真正例中的 TPR 相等）；equalised odds 是两条都要，条件更强

model_answer.en: Equalised odds requires the same true positive rate and the same false positive rate in every group, i.e. P(yhat = 1 | y, A = a) does not depend on a for y = 0 and for y = 1. Equal opportunity asks only for equal true positive rates, so equalised odds is the stronger condition.
model_answer.zh:
Equalised odds requires the same true positive rate and the same false positive rate in every group, i.e. P(yhat = 1 | y, A = a) does not depend on a for y = 0 and for y = 1. Equal opportunity asks only for equal true positive rates, so equalised odds is the stronger condition.

（考试用英文作答，以上是一份英文参考答案。）

explain.en: Write the condition as a conditional probability given the true label; that is what separates it from predictive parity (conditioning on the prediction).
explain.zh: 把条件写成“给定真实标签”的条件概率；这正是它和 predictive parity（条件是预测）的区别。

text.en: Show the setup, not only the answer; the marks are for the method. Each question below has fresh numbers and says how to round. The explanation shows the working you would write.
text.zh: 写出式子，不要只写答案：分数给方法。下面每题数字都是新的，题目说明怎么取整。解析里是你该写的过程。

prompt.en: A node holds 12 instances, 8 positive and 4 negative. A binary feature splits it into a branch with 4 instances (all positive) and a branch with 8 instances (4 positive, 4 negative). Compute the information gain in bits. [4 marks] Answer to 3 decimal places.
prompt.zh: 一个节点有 12 个样本，8 正 4 负。一个二值特征把它分成两个分支：一支 4 个样本（全是正例），另一支 8 个样本（4 正 4 负）。计算信息增益（单位 bit）。[4 分] 保留 3 位小数。

explain.en: $H(\text{parent}) = H(\tfrac23, \tfrac13) = 0.9183$. The pure branch has $H = 0$; the balanced one has $H = 1$. $\mathrm{IG} = 0.9183 - \tfrac{4}{12}\cdot 0 - \tfrac{8}{12}\cdot 1 = 0.252$.
explain.zh: $H(\text{父节点}) = H(\tfrac23, \tfrac13) = 0.9183$。纯分支 $H = 0$，均衡分支 $H = 1$。$\mathrm{IG} = 0.9183 - \tfrac{4}{12}\cdot 0 - \tfrac{8}{12}\cdot 1 = 0.252$。

hints.en: Weight each branch's entropy by its share of the 12 instances.
hints.zh: 每个分支的熵按它占 12 个样本的比例加权。

prompt.en: A three-valued feature splits 12 instances into groups of 6, 4 and 2, and its information gain is 0.30 bits. Compute its gain ratio. [3 marks] Answer to 3 decimal places.
prompt.zh: 一个三值特征把 12 个样本分成 6、4、2 三组，它的信息增益是 0.30 bit。计算它的增益率。[3 分] 保留 3 位小数。

explain.en: $\mathrm{SI} = -(\tfrac12\log_2\tfrac12 + \tfrac13\log_2\tfrac13 + \tfrac16\log_2\tfrac16) = 1.4591$, so $\mathrm{GR} = 0.30/\mathrm{SI} = 0.206$. Splitting into many groups raises SplitInfo, which is how gain ratio punishes it.
explain.zh: $\mathrm{SI} = -(\tfrac12\log_2\tfrac12 + \tfrac13\log_2\tfrac13 + \tfrac16\log_2\tfrac16) = 1.4591$，所以 $\mathrm{GR} = 0.30/1.4591 = 0.206$。分成的组越多 SplitInfo 越大，增益率就是这样惩罚它的。

title.zh: 带拉普拉斯平滑的朴素贝叶斯

prompt.en: Training set: 10 emails, 6 spam and 4 ham. The word *offer* appears in 5 spam and 1 ham emails; the word *meeting* in 1 spam and 3 ham emails (binary features, absent otherwise). Using naive Bayes with Laplace smoothing ($\alpha = 1$, $V = 2$ for each feature; the priors are the plain proportions), compute $P(\text{spam} \mid \text{offer present, meeting absent})$. [6 marks] Answer to 3 decimal places.
prompt.zh: 训练集 10 封邮件，6 封垃圾、4 封正常。词 *offer* 出现在 5 封垃圾邮件和 1 封正常邮件里；词 *meeting* 出现在 1 封垃圾邮件和 3 封正常邮件里（二值特征）。用带拉普拉斯平滑（每个特征 $\alpha = 1$，$V = 2$；先验用直接的比例）的朴素贝叶斯，计算 $P(\text{垃圾} \mid \text{有 offer、没有 meeting})$。[6 分] 保留 3 位小数。

hints.en: For the absent word you need $P(\text{absent} \mid c)$: the count of emails *without* it, plus 1.
hints.zh: 没出现的词要用 $P(\text{没出现} \mid c)$：*没有*该词的邮件数，加 1。

prompt.en: Training points (Euclidean distance): A at (3, 4), B at (6, 3), B at (3, 7), A at (0, 0), A at (9, 9). Classify the query (3, 3) with $k = 3$ and weights $w = 1/d$. What is the total weight of class B among the three neighbours? [4 marks] Answer to 3 decimal places.
prompt.zh: 训练点（欧氏距离）：A 在 (3, 4)，B 在 (6, 3)，B 在 (3, 7)，A 在 (0, 0)，A 在 (9, 9)。对查询点 (3, 3) 取 $k = 3$、权重 $w = 1/d$ 分类。三个近邻里类别 B 的总权重是多少？[4 分] 保留 3 位小数。

explain.en: Distances: (3,4) is 1, (6,3) is 3, (3,7) is 4, so these are the three nearest. Class A: $1/1 = 1.0$. Class B: $1/3 + 1/4 = 0.583$. Plain majority voting would pick B (2 votes to 1), but weighted voting picks A, because the A point is much closer.
explain.zh: 距离：(3,4) 是 1，(6,3) 是 3，(3,7) 是 4，所以这三个是最近的。类别 A：$1/1 = 1.0$。类别 B：$1/3 + 1/4 = 0.583$。简单多数投票会选 B（2 票对 1 票），加权投票却选 A，因为 A 的那个点近得多。

prompt.en: A logistic regression has $\theta = (\theta_0, \theta_1, \theta_2) = (-1, 2, 0.5)$. For the instance $\mathbf{x} = (1, 1, 2)$ (the first 1 is the bias input) with label $y = 0$, take one gradient descent step on the cross-entropy loss with $\eta = 0.5$. What is the new $\theta_2$? [5 marks] Answer to 3 decimal places.
prompt.zh: 逻辑回归 $\theta = (\theta_0, \theta_1, \theta_2) = (-1, 2, 0.5)$。对样本 $\mathbf{x} = (1, 1, 2)$（第一个 1 是偏置输入），标签 $y = 0$，在交叉熵损失上做一步梯度下降，$\eta = 0.5$。新的 $\theta_2$ 是多少？[5 分] 保留 3 位小数。

explain.en: $z = -1 + 2 + 0.5\cdot 2 = 2$, $\hat{y} = \sigma(2) = 0.8808$. The gradient for $\theta_2$ is $(\hat{y} - y)x_2 = 0.8808 \times 2 = 1.7616$. $\theta_2 \leftarrow 0.5 - 0.5 \times 1.7616 = -0.381$. The model was confidently wrong ($\hat{y} \approx 0.88$, $y = 0$), so the weight on the large feature moves down a lot.
explain.zh: $z = -1 + 2 + 0.5\cdot 2 = 2$，$\hat{y} = \sigma(2) = 0.8808$。$\theta_2$ 的梯度是 $(\hat{y} - y)x_2 = 0.8808 \times 2 = 1.7616$。$\theta_2 \leftarrow 0.5 - 0.5 \times 1.7616 = -0.381$。模型错得很自信（$\hat{y} \approx 0.88$，$y = 0$），所以大特征上的权重降得很多。

prompt.en: A perceptron has $\theta = (0.5, -1, 1)$ (bias first), labels $\pm 1$, and the instance $\mathbf{x} = (1, 2, 1)$ has $y = +1$. It is misclassified, so update with $\eta = 0.5$. What is $\theta^\top\mathbf{x}$ after the update? [3 marks] Answer to 1 decimal place.
prompt.zh: 感知机 $\theta = (0.5, -1, 1)$（偏置在前），标签取 $\pm 1$，样本 $\mathbf{x} = (1, 2, 1)$ 的 $y = +1$。它被分错了，用 $\eta = 0.5$ 更新。更新后 $\theta^\top\mathbf{x}$ 是多少？[3 分] 保留 1 位小数。

explain.en: Before: $\theta^\top\mathbf{x} = 0.5 - 2 + 1 = -0.5$ (negative, so predicted $-1$, wrong). Update: $\theta \leftarrow \theta + 0.5 \cdot (+1)\cdot\mathbf{x} = (1.00, 0.00, 1.50)$. After: $1.00 + 2\cdot 0.00 + 1.50 = 2.5$. Check: it grew by $\eta\lVert\mathbf{x}\rVert^2 = 0.5 \times 6 = 3.0$, from $-0.5$ to $2.5$.
explain.zh: 更新前：$\theta^\top\mathbf{x} = 0.5 - 2 + 1 = -0.5$（为负，预测 $-1$，错）。更新：$\theta \leftarrow \theta + 0.5 \cdot (+1)\cdot\mathbf{x} = (1.00, 0.00, 1.50)$。更新后：$1.00 + 2\cdot 0.00 + 1.50 = 2.5$。检验：它增加了 $\eta\lVert\mathbf{x}\rVert^2 = 0.5 \times 6 = 3.0$，从 $-0.5$ 到 $2.5$。

prompt.en: A linear SVM has $\mathbf{w} = (6, 8)$ and $b = -5$. What is the width of the margin, the distance between the hyperplanes $\mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{x} + b = \pm 1$? [2 marks] Answer to 2 decimal places.
prompt.zh: 一个线性 SVM 的 $\mathbf{w} = (6, 8)$，$b = -5$。间隔的宽度，也就是超平面 $\mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{x} + b = \pm 1$ 之间的距离，是多少？[2 分] 保留 2 位小数。

explain.en: $\lVert\mathbf{w}\rVert = \sqrt{36 + 64} = 10$, so the width is $2/\lVert\mathbf{w}\rVert = 0.20$. ($b$ moves the boundary but does not change the width.) The point $(1, 1)$ gives $\mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{x} + b = 9 \ge 1$: it is far outside the margin, at distance $9/10 = 0.9$ from the boundary.
explain.zh: $\lVert\mathbf{w}\rVert = \sqrt{36 + 64} = 10$，所以宽度是 $2/\lVert\mathbf{w}\rVert = 0.20$。（$b$ 平移边界，不改变宽度。）点 $(1, 1)$ 的 $\mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{x} + b = 9 \ge 1$：远在间隔之外，到边界的距离是 $9/10 = 0.9$。

prompt.en: A 3-class classifier has this confusion matrix (rows = actual class, columns = predicted), classes X, Y, Z: X = (8, 1, 1), Y = (2, 6, 2), Z = (0, 1, 9). Compute the macro-averaged $F_1$ (average the three per-class $F_1$ values). [5 marks] Answer to 3 decimal places.
prompt.zh: 一个三分类器的混淆矩阵（行 = 真实类别，列 = 预测类别），类别 X、Y、Z：X = (8, 1, 1)，Y = (2, 6, 2)，Z = (0, 1, 9)。计算宏平均 $F_1$（三个类别的 $F_1$ 取平均）。[5 分] 保留 3 位小数。

prompt.en: Among 200 documents, the word *goal* occurs in 40, the class *sport* has 50 documents, and 30 documents are both. Compute $\mathrm{PMI}(\textit{goal}, \textit{sport})$ in bits. [3 marks] Answer to 2 decimal places.
prompt.zh: 200 篇文档中，词 *goal* 出现在 40 篇里，类别 *sport* 有 50 篇，两者同时成立的有 30 篇。计算 $\mathrm{PMI}(\textit{goal}, \textit{sport})$（单位 bit）。[3 分] 保留 2 位小数。

explain.en: $P(\text{goal}, \text{sport}) = 30/200 = 0.15$, $P(\text{goal}) = 0.2$, $P(\text{sport}) = 0.25$. $\mathrm{PMI} = \log_2\frac{0.15}{0.2 \times 0.25} = \log_2 3 = 1.585$. Positive: the word occurs with the class three times as often as chance (independence would give 0).
explain.zh: $P(\text{goal}, \text{sport}) = 30/200 = 0.15$，$P(\text{goal}) = 0.2$，$P(\text{sport}) = 0.25$。$\mathrm{PMI} = \log_2\frac{0.15}{0.2 \times 0.25} = \log_2 3 = 1.585$。为正：这个词和该类同时出现的频率是随机情形的三倍（独立时为 0）。

prompt.en: One-dimensional data 1, 2, 6, 7, 12 and $k = 2$ with initial centroids 2 and 7. Assign each point to its nearest centroid and recompute. What is the new position of the second centroid (the one that started at 7)? [3 marks] Answer to 2 decimal places.
prompt.zh: 一维数据 1, 2, 6, 7, 12，$k = 2$，初始中心 2 和 7。把每个点分给最近的中心，再重新计算。第二个中心（原来在 7 的那个）的新位置是多少？[3 分] 保留 2 位小数。

explain.en: Distances: 1 and 2 are nearest to centroid 2; 6 (distance 4 vs 1), 7 and 12 are nearest to centroid 7. New second centroid $= (6 + 7 + 12)/3 = 8.33$; the first becomes $(1 + 2)/2 = 1.5$. The next assignment would stay the same, so k-means stops.
explain.zh: 距离：1 和 2 离中心 2 最近；6（距离 4 对 1）、7、12 离中心 7 最近。新的第二个中心 $= (6 + 7 + 12)/3 = 8.33$；第一个变成 $(1 + 2)/2 = 1.5$。下一次分配不会变，k-means 就此停止。

prompt.en: AdaBoost starts with 5 instances of weight 0.2 each. The first classifier misclassifies exactly one of them. After updating and normalising, what is the weight of each correctly classified instance? [4 marks] Answer to 3 decimal places.
prompt.zh: AdaBoost 开始时 5 个样本权重各为 0.2。第一个分类器恰好分错其中一个。更新并归一化后，每个分对样本的权重是多少？[4 分] 保留 3 位小数。

explain.en: $\varepsilon = 0.2$, so $\alpha = \tfrac12\ln(0.8/0.2) = 0.693$. Correct: $0.2 e^{-\alpha} = 0.10$ each (four of them); wrong: $0.2 e^{\alpha} = 0.40$. The total is $Z = 0.80$. Normalised: correct $= 0.125$ each, wrong $= 0.500$. The misclassified instance now carries weight $0.5$, as always after a round.
explain.zh: $\varepsilon = 0.2$，所以 $\alpha = \tfrac12\ln(0.8/0.2) = 0.693$。分对的：每个 $0.2 e^{-\alpha} = 0.10$（共四个）；分错的：$0.2 e^{\alpha} = 0.40$。总和 $Z = 0.80$。归一化后：分对的每个 $= 0.125$，分错的 $= 0.500$。分错的那个现在占 $0.5$，每一轮之后都是这样。

say.en: Forward: the hidden unit sees $x = 1$ through the weight $w = 0.5$.
say.zh: 前向：隐藏单元通过权重 $w = 0.5$ 看到 $x = 1$。

say.en: Forward: the output unit has weight $v = 1$.
say.zh: 前向：输出单元的权重是 $v = 1$。

say.en: The same sigmoid. The label is $y = 1$, so the prediction is too low.
say.zh: 同样的 sigmoid。标签是 $y = 1$，所以预测偏低。

say.en: Loss: binary cross-entropy with $y = 1$ keeps only the first term.
say.zh: 损失：二元交叉熵，$y = 1$ 时只剩第一项。

say.en: Backward: for a sigmoid output with cross-entropy, the output error term is simply prediction minus target.
say.zh: 反向：sigmoid 输出加交叉熵时，输出层的误差项就是预测减目标。

why.en: The sigmoid derivative $\hat{y}(1 - \hat{y})$ cancels with the cross-entropy derivative $-y/\hat{y} + (1 - y)/(1 - \hat{y})$.
why.zh: sigmoid 的导数 $\hat{y}(1 - \hat{y})$ 和交叉熵的导数 $-y/\hat{y} + (1 - y)/(1 - \hat{y})$ 恰好约掉。

say.en: Backward: send $\delta_2$ back through $v$, then multiply by the sigmoid slope $a_1(1 - a_1)$ of the hidden unit. Write this expression with $d$ for $\delta_2$, $v$ the weight and $a$ for $a_1$.
say.zh: 反向：把 $\delta_2$ 经过 $v$ 送回，再乘隐藏单元的 sigmoid 斜率 $a_1(1 - a_1)$。用 $d$ 表示 $\delta_2$，$v$ 为权重，$a$ 表示 $a_1$，写出这个表达式。

say.en: Gradients: a weight's gradient is its unit's error term times what came in along that weight.
say.zh: 梯度：权重的梯度 = 所在单元的误差项 × 沿这个权重进来的值。

say.en: The same rule for the hidden weight; its input is $x = 1$.
say.zh: 隐藏层的权重同一条规则；它的输入是 $x = 1$。

say.en: Update with $\eta = 1$: both gradients are negative, so both weights rise and $\hat{y}$ moves toward 1.
say.zh: 用 $\eta = 1$ 更新：两个梯度都为负，所以两个权重都上升，$\hat{y}$ 向 1 靠近。

intro.en: A network with one input $x = 1$, one hidden sigmoid unit (weight $w = 0.5$) and one sigmoid output unit (weight $v = 1$), trained with binary cross-entropy on the target $y = 1$. Do one step of backpropagation with $\eta = 1$. [8 marks]
intro.zh: 一个网络：输入 $x = 1$，一个 sigmoid 隐藏单元（权重 $w = 0.5$），一个 sigmoid 输出单元（权重 $v = 1$），用二元交叉熵训练，目标 $y = 1$。用 $\eta = 1$ 做一步反向传播。[8 分]

outro.en: With the new weights the output rises from 0.6508 to 0.6859, and the loss falls from 0.4296 to 0.3770. Always do this check: the loss must go down after a small enough step.
outro.zh: 用新权重，输出从 0.6508 升到 0.6859，损失从 0.4296 降到 0.3770。这个检验每次都要做：步子足够小，损失必然下降。

prompt.en: Write $\delta_1$ in terms of $d = \delta_2$, $v$ and $a = a_1$.
prompt.zh: 用 $d = \delta_2$、$v$ 和 $a = a_1$ 写出 $\delta_1$。

title.zh: C 部分：设计并说明理由

text.en: A third of a page or more. These questions have no single right answer; marks go to a *structure* the marker can follow, and every choice tied to a property of the data or the method.
text.zh: 至少三分之一页。这类题没有唯一的标准答案；分数给一个阅卷人跟得上的*结构*，以及每个选择都有数据或方法的某个性质作依据。

items.en: **Restate the problem in ML terms**: task, data, the constraint that matters (imbalance, few labels, noise, interpretability).
items.zh: **用机器学习的话重述问题**：任务、数据、最要紧的约束（不均衡、标签少、噪声、可解释性）。

items.en: **Choose a method and say why**, tying each reason to a property: bias/variance, assumptions, cost, interpretability.
items.zh: **选方法并说理由**，每条理由对应一个性质：偏差/方差、假设、成本、可解释性。

items.en: **Say how you will evaluate**: the metric (and why not accuracy), the strategy (cross-validation, hold-out), the baseline.
items.zh: **说明怎么评估**：指标（以及为什么不用准确率）、策略（交叉验证、留出）、基线。

items.en: **Name a risk and the remedy**: leakage, overfitting, confirmation bias, fairness.
items.zh: **点出一个风险和对策**：泄漏、过拟合、确认偏差、公平性。

text.en: Do not write everything you know about the topic: write what this problem needs.
text.zh: 不要把知道的全写上：只写这个问题需要的。

title.en: A rare disease with few labels

prompt.en: A hospital wants to predict a rare disease (about 2% of patients) from 40 laboratory measurements. It has 300 labelled patients (6 with the disease) and 20,000 unlabelled records. Choose and justify a learning approach and an evaluation strategy, and name one risk. [12 marks]
prompt.zh: 医院想根据 40 项化验指标预测一种罕见病（约 2% 的病人患病）。手上有 300 个有标签的病人（其中 6 人患病）和 20,000 条无标签记录。选择并论证一种学习方法和评估策略，并指出一个风险。[12 分]

key_points.en: Frames the problem: binary classification, severe class imbalance (2%), very few positives (6), many features relative to positives, so high-variance models overfit
key_points.zh: 把问题说清：二分类、严重不均衡（2%）、正例极少（6 个）、特征数相对正例很多，所以高方差模型会过拟合

key_points.en: Chooses a low-variance, simple model (e.g. regularised logistic regression or naive Bayes) with feature selection; justified by few positives; may add semi-supervised or active learning for the 20,000 unlabelled records, with a caveat
key_points.zh: 选低方差的简单模型（如正则化逻辑回归或朴素贝叶斯）加特征选择，理由是正例太少；可用半监督或主动学习利用 20,000 条无标签记录，并说明注意事项

key_points.en: Evaluation: stratified cross-validation (every fold needs positives); metrics precision, recall, F1 on the disease class or a precision-recall curve, not accuracy (always predicting healthy gives 98%)
key_points.zh: 评估：分层交叉验证（每折都要有正例）；用患病类的 precision、recall、F1 或 PR 曲线，不用准确率（全猜健康就有 98%）

key_points.en: Names a risk with a remedy: e.g. select features inside each fold to avoid leakage; self-training can reinforce its own errors (confirmation bias); threshold chosen for the cost of a missed case
key_points.zh: 指出风险并给对策：如特征选择放在每一折内部以避免泄漏；自训练会强化自己的错误（确认偏差）；阈值按漏诊的代价来定

key_points.en: Compares with a baseline (majority class) and says which error matters more (a missed disease)
key_points.zh: 与基线（多数类）比较，并说明哪种错误更要紧（漏诊）

model_answer.en:
Problem: binary classification with severe imbalance (2%) and only 6 positives among 300 labelled patients, with 40 features. A flexible model would overfit the 6 positives, so I would use a low-variance model such as L2-regularised logistic regression or naive Bayes, after a filter selection of features (e.g. mutual information with the label) to cut the dimension. The 20,000 unlabelled records could help through self-training or active learning (asking a doctor to label the most uncertain cases), but self-training can reinforce its own mistakes, so I would only add high-confidence labels and check their effect.
Evaluation: accuracy is useless here (always predicting "healthy" gives 98%). I would report precision, recall and F1 on the disease class, and a precision-recall curve, because missing a patient is the costly error; the decision threshold is chosen for that cost. With so few positives I would use stratified k-fold cross-validation so every fold contains positives, compared with a majority-class baseline.
Risk: leakage. Feature selection and any scaling must be done inside each training fold, otherwise the estimate is optimistic.

explain.en: A full-mark answer follows the four-part structure: the problem in ML terms, the choice and its reasons, the evaluation with its metric, a risk with its remedy.
explain.zh: 满分答案按四部分结构走：用机器学习的话重述问题、选择及理由、带指标的评估、一个风险及对策。

prompt.en: An unpruned decision tree on 300 features has a training error near 2% and a validation error near 25%. As the training set grows from 100 to 5,000 instances the two curves move closer but a large gap remains. Diagnose the problem and propose and justify three changes. How would the curves change if the fixes work, and how would the diagnosis differ if both errors were about 25%? [12 marks]
prompt.zh: 一棵没有剪枝的决策树，在 300 个特征上训练误差约 2%，验证误差约 25%。训练集从 100 增加到 5,000 个样本时，两条曲线靠近了一些，但仍有很大差距。诊断问题，并提出并论证三项改动。如果这些改动有效，曲线会怎样变化？如果两个误差都约为 25%，诊断会有什么不同？[12 分]

key_points.en: Diagnosis: high variance / overfitting (low training error, large gap to validation error); an unpruned tree fits noise
key_points.zh: 诊断：高方差 / 过拟合（训练误差低，与验证误差差距大）；未剪枝的树在拟合噪声

key_points.en: Fix 1 and 2, each justified: reduce complexity (limit max depth or prune), reduce features (filter by MI/information gain), or add data (the gap is closing slowly with more data)
key_points.zh: 改动 1、2，各说理由：降低复杂度（限制最大深度或剪枝）、减少特征（按 MI/信息增益过滤）、或增加数据（差距随数据增多缓慢收窄）

key_points.en: Fix 3: bagging / random forest averages many trees and reduces variance (boosting targets bias, so not the first choice)
key_points.zh: 改动 3：bagging / 随机森林对许多棵树取平均，降低方差（boosting 针对偏差，所以不是首选）

key_points.en: Expected effect: training error rises slightly, validation error falls, gap narrows; evaluate with cross-validation
key_points.zh: 预期效果：训练误差略升，验证误差下降，差距缩小；用交叉验证评估

key_points.en: If both errors were about 25% and close: high bias / underfitting; fixes would go the other way (more complex model, more features, boosting)
key_points.zh: 如果两个误差都约 25% 且接近：高偏差 / 欠拟合；对策反过来（更复杂的模型、更多特征、boosting）

model_answer.en:
Diagnosis: the training error is tiny and the validation error is far higher, with a persistent gap, so the model has high variance (overfitting): an unpruned tree can memorise noise in 300 features.
Changes: (1) Limit the complexity of the tree, by a maximum depth or pruning, which stops it fitting noise. (2) Reduce the number of features, e.g. keep those with the highest information gain / mutual information with the label, since many irrelevant features give the tree more chances to split on noise. (3) Use bagging (a random forest): averaging trees trained on bootstrap samples reduces variance without raising bias much. More data would also help, since the gap was still closing at 5,000 instances, but it is often costly.
Expected effect: training error goes up a little, validation error goes down, and the two curves get closer. I would check this with cross-validation, choosing the depth by validation error.
If both errors were about 25% and close together, the problem would be high bias (underfitting): the model is too simple for the data. The fixes reverse: a more complex model, more informative features, or boosting. More data alone would not help.

explain.en: The structure is diagnosis, then fixes tied to the diagnosis, then the expected effect, then the contrast case. Every fix names the reason it works.
explain.zh: 结构：先诊断，再给与诊断相符的改动，然后是预期效果，最后对比另一种情形。每项改动都说出它为什么有效。
